sloka: भवन्तो मम सर्वस्वं भवन्तो जीवितं मम ।भवद्भिश्च कृतं राज्यं पालयामि नरेश्वराः ।। ७.४४.१९ ॥
transliteration: bhavanto mama sarvasvaṁ bhavanto jīvitaṁ mama ।bhavadbhiśca kṛtaṁ rājyaṁ pālayāmi nareśvarāḥ ।। 7.44.19 ॥

translations.english: Rama declared to the kings that they were his everything and his very life, and that he ruled the kingdom which they had helped establish.
